bayespk: Bayesian population pharmacokinetics without writing Stan

Source: R/bayespk-package.R
bayespk-package.Rd

Fits 1- and 2-compartment linear population pharmacokinetic models to NONMEM-style data with precompiled Stan programs based on closed-form solutions.

References

Stan Development Team. RStan: the R interface to Stan. https://mc-stan.org
